title: Mind Flow claim firewall policy v2
description: The closed policy contract paired with claim-ledger v2. Changes require a new policy and schema version.

purpose.const: Bind exact public-language atoms to explicit epistemic, provenance, support, review and publication records without treating structural validity as truth or authority.

hash_contract.const: sha256 over the exact UTF-8 bytes of each statement with no whitespace or Unicode normalisation

publication_rule.const: approved-by-governance-record is a recorded disposition only; a machine-valid ledger does not authenticate the authority record or determine publishability

truth_rule.const: support_state records an assessment; it does not establish truth

atomicity_rule.const: each atomic claim has one epistemic_class, one provenance_role, one support_state and one publication_disposition; a source sentence may reference multiple atomic claims

challenge_rule.const: every atomic claim binds a counterclaim and a falsifier or explicit governance revision condition

lineage_rule.const: replacement edges are directed, acyclic, review-bound and preserve both immutable claims
